title: Varley Manning Sweatshirt, Black, Size S

comparisons.notes: Varley Manning Sweatshirt in Black, style VAR00015, size S, in stock.

writeup: Woot has the Varley Manning Sweatshirt in black, size S, new, for $44.99. It's a ribbed knit crew in a cotton and poly blend with side zips at the hem and a dropped back hem. Blackskinny sells the same style (VAR00015) for $110, so this is about 59% less. Woot listed it under men's, but the style is Varley's women's Manning. Only 1 was left when we checked.
